rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when one thing dominates another and makes it seem less important.

example.english: The special effects in this film overshadow the story itself.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅特技效果蓋過咗劇情本身。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hei3 ge3 dak6 gei6 haau6 gwo2 goi3 gwo3 zo2 kek6 cing4 bun2 san1

rows.note: Use this when a person or event gets all the attention and overshadows another in a social or public situation.

example.english: The child’s antics overshadow the bride and groom at the wedding.
example.traditional: 個細路喺婚禮上搶晒風頭，搞到新郎新娘冇人理。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6 coeng2 saai3 fung1 tau4 gaau2 dou3 san1 long4 san1 noeng2 mou5 jan4 lei5

rows.note: Use this for a physical object blocking light or casting a shadow over something.

example.english: That big tree seems to overshadow the windows of the house.
example.traditional: 嗰棵大樹遮住咗間屋啲窗。
example.jyutping: go2 fo2 daai6 syu6 ze1 zyu6 zo2 gaan1 uk1 di1 coeng1
